The overall performance of solar 
farms decreased by 2.8% YoY, 
mainly due to the ongoing SPN 
repowering project. In terms of 
solar irradiance, it was higher YoY 
in Japan but showed a significant 
decline in Vietnam and Mongolia.Wind farm performance 
remained the highlight of the 
year, mainly due to the full 
operational recognition of the 
Winchai project, even with the 
effect from the TTTV subsea 
cable repair in 1H25. Positive 
factors from higher wind speeds 
YoY in Thailand supported a 13.4% 
YoY growth in performance.Even though raw material costs 
slightly increased, the 
performance of biomass power 
plants continued to grow by 0.5%, 
driven by fewer maintenance 
shutdown days compared to last 
year.COD of 4 new projects in Thailand 
during the third quarter brought 
the total capacity of the solar 
rooftop business to 49 MW. Overall 
performance for the 9M25 
increased by 3.1% YoY, mainly due 
contribution from new projects, 
despite lower solar irradiance in 
both Thailand and Indonesia.
❑ Ft rate drop YoY affected SPN  and Winchai 
project in Thailand 
❑Appreciation in Thai baht affected revenue 
recognition in Foreign projects 
❑The Company received the SET ESG Rating of "AA"  
(80-89 total score) in the Resources industry from the 
announcement of the SET ESG Ratings 2024 by SET.
❑The Company was awarded a 5-star CGR rating by IOD , 
reflecting excellence in corporate governance and 
fostering confidence among the company's shareholders.CGR rating

## Page 13

Revenue from electricity sales and services
Revenue from electricity sales, services and other products decreased by 12.3% YoY.
•Revenue from electricity sales decreased by 105.6 MB or 12.8%, mainly due to the 
expiration of the SPN adder. Additionally, the Ft rate dropped YoY, and appreciation of 
the Thai baht affected revenue recognition.
•Revenue from services and other products increased by 1.9 MB or 10.7%, mainly from 
revenue generated by the flexible packaging business.Revenue from electricity sales, services and other products decreased by 8.7% YoY. 
•Revenue from electricity sales decreased by 200.1 MB, or 8.3%, despite full revenue recognition 
from the 100% stake in Winchai and higher wind speeds YoY. The decline was mainly due to the 
expiration of the SPN adder and the ongoing repowering process, including the TTTV subsea 
cable repair, which put pressure on revenue. Moreover, the decrease in the Ft rate and the 
appreciation of the Thai baht remained challenging factors during the year.
•Revenue from services and other products decreased by 15.5 MB or 19.6% from a drop in 
revenue from EPC projects.Solar
